_note: tenders-run-on-the-tender-case-type 1.1 (row 2.54). The records a tender is worked with: bids (REQ-TND-007) and supplier questions (REQ-TND-004) on the tender case or its lots, one evaluation per evaluator per bid (REQ-EVA-001), and scoring formulas as data (REQ-EVA-003). The award is a decision on the case (REQ-EVA-002), so no award schema. In the register rather than the aanbesteding package because the package installer ships no schemas yet. States follow declared lifecycles; no bid, question or evaluation service decides them. Seeds the three common methods (lowest price, relative price, best price-quality ratio); a tender office adds its own as records.

bid.title: Bid
bid.description: One supplier's submission (inschrijving) on a tender case or one of its lots (REQ-TND-007). Its state follows a declared lifecycle; no bid service decides it.

tender.description: The tender case the bid is for.
tender.title: Tender

lot.description: The lot (a child case of the tender) when the bid is for one lot.
lot.title: Lot

case.description: The case the bid shows on: the tender itself or the lot.
case.title: Case

supplier.description: The supplier who submitted the bid.
supplier.title: Supplier

submissionRef.description: The reference of the bid in the tender platform (such as TenderNed, Mercell or Negometrix).
submissionRef.title: Submission reference

priceAmount.title: Price
priceAmount.description: The bid price excluding VAT, where the procedure asks for a price.

responses.title: Responses
responses.description: The supplier's response per award criterion, by criterion key.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: The bid documents the supplier uploaded.

state.title: State
state.description: Received, admissible, inadmissible, excluded, evaluated or withdrawn.

admissibilityNotes.title: Admissibility notes
admissibilityNotes.description: Why the bid was found admissible, inadmissible or excluded.

evaluationScore.title: Evaluation score
evaluationScore.description: The score per award criterion, set while the bids are evaluated.

admit.description: The bid meets the formal requirements and goes on to evaluation.

declareInadmissible.description: The bid does not meet the formal requirements, or arrived after the closing date.

exclude.description: The supplier is excluded on a ground of exclusion.

markEvaluated.description: Every evaluation of the bid is final.

withdraw.description: The supplier withdrew the bid before the award.

tenderQuestion.title: Tender question
tenderQuestion.description: A question a supplier asked about a tender, and the answer that becomes part of the published nota van inlichtingen (REQ-TND-004).

tender.description: The tender case the question is about.
tender.title: Tender

lot.description: The lot the question is about, when it concerns one lot.
lot.title: Lot

submittedBy.title: Asked by
submittedBy.description: The supplier, or an anonymised handle when the procedure keeps suppliers anonymous.

publishedAt.description: When the answer was published in the nota van inlichtingen.
publishedAt.title: Published at

noi.title: Nota van inlichtingen
noi.description: The published nota van inlichtingen the answer is part of.

state.title: State
state.description: Received, under review, answered, published or rejected.

answer.description: The answer is written and waits for publication.

publish.description: The answer is published in the nota van inlichtingen, for every supplier.

reject.description: The question is not answered, for instance because it came after the question deadline.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.description: One evaluator's scores for one bid (REQ-EVA-001): a panel of three gives three evaluations per bid. The award itself is a decision on the case, not an evaluation.

tender.description: The tender case the bid is for.
tender.title: Tender

evaluator.title: Evaluator
evaluator.description: The user id of the evaluator.

criterionScores.title: Scores
criterionScores.description: The score and the reasoning per award criterion, by criterion key.

weightedTotal.title: Weighted total
weightedTotal.description: The total the tender's scoring formula gives over the criterion scores.

state.title: State
state.description: Draft, submitted, calibrated, finalised or withdrawn.

calibrationNotes.title: Calibration notes
calibrationNotes.description: What the panel agreed when it compared the scores.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Documents that support the scores, such as the evaluator's report.

submit.description: The evaluator hands in the scores.

calibrate.description: The panel compared the scores and settled them.

finalise.description: The scores are final and count towards the ranking.

withdraw.description: The evaluation is withdrawn, for instance because the evaluator had a conflict of interest.

scoringFormula.title: Scoring formula
scoringFormula.description: A scoring method as data (REQ-EVA-003): an arithmetic expression over named values. A new method is a new record, not a code change.

key.title: Key
key.description: The key a tender's award criterion names the formula by.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: The arithmetic expression over the named values (+ - * / and max, min, round, abs).

variables.title: Values
variables.description: The names of the values the expression uses.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the formula does and when to use it.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether new tenders may choose the formula.

objects.title: Lowest price
objects.description: The lowest price gets the most points; every other bid in proportion to how close it comes.

objects.title: Relative price
objects.description: The lowest price gets the most points; a bid loses points by how far, in percent, it is above the lowest price, down to none.

objects.title: Best price-quality ratio
objects.expression: round(qualityWeight * quality + priceWeight * maxPoints * lowestPrice / price, 2)
objects.description: The weighted quality score plus the weighted price score, the price scored as with the lowest price.
